t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Naka cantacotirirí, nashi nowabani abirotaqui ovettzikaquena, oncantcha niyotantaiymiri nancanenpi. Nocantaco timpi ironaa toshinttzitage pishinttzincaqui Noca nashinonca. Abiroka pashararo. Tekattzi pashini pawa. Abiroka pamitacotana ocavencati, abiroka añincari.
